title: Strict scalar pullback cone maps and their derived naturality
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ and uniformizers $\varpi_E,\varpi_L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism with $\ell$ invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $R_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$, $S_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,W}$, $B_{F,W,m}=(\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^m)_W$ for $W=X,Y$, $F=E,L$, $m\ge1$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use the quotient maps $\iota_m:\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m\to\mathcal O_L/\varpi_L^m$ and $\rho_m=(\iota_m)_Y\pi^E_m$ of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. For any cochain complex $P$ of $R_Y$-modules put $Q=P\otimes_{R_Y}S_Y$; tensor products are sheaf tensor products [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For an $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,Y}$-complex $M$ put
$$D^F_m(M)=\operatorname{Res}^F_m g_{F,m}^*(M\otimes B_{F,Y,m}),\qquad A_F(M)=\operatorname{Cone}(1-s:\prod_mD^F_m(M)\to\prod_mD^F_m(M))[-1],$$
using module inverse image $g_{F,m}^*=g^{-1}(-)\otimes_{g^{-1}B_{F,Y,m}}B_{F,X,m}$, coefficient structure maps [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], restriction of scalars and quotient transitions [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. There is a natural strict tower map $d_m:D^E_m(P)\otimes_{R_X}S_X\to D^L_m(Q)$ uniquely specified on local tensor generators by
$$((g^{-1}(p\otimes\bar a))\otimes b)\otimes s\longmapsto(g^{-1}(p\otimes\iota_m(\bar a)))\otimes(\iota_m(b)\pi^L_m(s)).$$
These formulas are balanced, commute with the cochain differentials and every quotient transition, and are natural in all chain maps $P\to P'$. Since $S_X$ is a finite free $R_X$-module [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], the canonical tensor/product maps are isomorphisms, independent of a choice of finite free basis of $S_X$ over $R_X$, and identify $A_E(P)\otimes_{R_X}S_X$ with the Roos cone of $D^E_\bullet(P)\otimes_{R_X}S_X$. The induced chain map $\delta_P$ to $A_L(Q)$ sends both cone coordinates by $\prod_m d_m$. On flat-term K-flat representatives [def-pc-kflat-complex], these chain maps descend to a natural transformation
$$C_X Lg_E^*\longrightarrow Lg_L^* C_Y,\qquad C_WH=H\otimes^L_{R_W}S_W,$$
with representative $[\delta_P]$ under the canonical comparison isomorphisms of [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. In particular the represented morphism is independent of the K-flat resolution and natural for arbitrary derived morphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $E\subset L\subset F$ the level maps and cone maps compose to those for $E\subset F$ after the canonical tensor associators; for $L=E$ they are identities under the tensor unit identifications.
